summary: This Form 8-K reports the consummation of RRE Ventures Acquisition Corp.'s initial public offering (IPO) of 25,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $250 million in gross proceeds, and a concurrent private placement of warrants raising $7.01 million. Net proceeds were placed in a trust account. This is a routine IPO closing disclosure, not a special situation event. The filing includes an audited balance sheet reflecting the proceeds. No acquisition target, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation catalyst is announced. Therefore, the filing is classified as None.
